  Problem: The new timeline-evidence branch sets `SECURITY_FIX_PR_MERGED="true"` and lets the existing cycle-advancement block run, but never calls `backfill_validation_fix_issue_merged_label`. The validation fix-up path (per agents.md) explicitly invokes that helper after timeline evidence confirms a merged PR so the issue stops carrying the inconsistent `ai:ready-to-merge` label on a merged-and-closed issue; the security-pass path now creates the same inconsistent state that the terminal-label guard exists to prevent.
  Why it fails at runtime: A fix issue previously clobbered by the buggy post-merge phase swap (the very shape this PR fixes) reaches the poller with `ai:ready-to-merge`, `state=closed`, and a merged implementation PR. The new evidence check advances `security_pass_cycle` correctly, but the issue itself is never flipped to `ai:merged`. The next poller tick, the mention-only-failure diagnostic, the security-pass follow-up bookkeeping, and any audit report still read `ai:ready-to-merge` on a merged-and-closed issue — the exact label state that triggered #4379.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
